name: agy-imagegen
description: Generate images with Gemini (agy) or OpenAI gpt-image-2 (Codex) and save them where you want. Works in Claude Code, Codex and Antigravity.

interface.shortDescription: Generate images with OpenAI or Gemini and save them where you want
interface.longDescription: Turns a text description into an image file. Inside Codex it uses Codex's own image generation (gpt-image-2) and places the file where you ask; it can also drive the Antigravity CLI (agy) for Gemini. No permission bypass and no window automation: a wrapper script copies the result to your chosen path, converting between PNG, JPEG, BMP and GIF if needed. Windows + PowerShell.
defaultPrompt: Generate an image of a red fox in a snowy forest, watercolor style.
Make a flat vector logo for my coffee shop.
Draw a cozy cabin at night and save it to my Pictures folder.
